title: Alpha-amino-acid count vs U.S. regulatory status: popular metabolic and peptide drugs
method: Each count is the number of residues in the FDA GSRS protein subunit sequence(s), summed across chains for two-chain insulins. Backbone residues that are chemically modified (Aib, alpha-methyl-leucine, acylated lysine, amidated C-terminus) count once; side chains attached to a lysine (fatty diacids, gamma-glutamate, ADO/AEEA linkers) are not counted, matching FDA's October 2, 2026 retatrutide decision. 21 CFR 600.3(h)(6): a protein is an alpha amino acid polymer with a specific, defined sequence greater than 40 amino acids.
rule: 21 CFR 600.3(h)(6); FDA letter to Lilly, Oct 2, 2026 (7th Cir. No. 26-1301, Dkt. 46-2)
